method: Native Pillow pixel construction with integer coordinates; no resampling. The prompts document the visual and layout contracts implemented by generate.py.
styleGuide: Top-down 3/4 pixel art for a dark, cozy Victorian mystery game. Strict integer pixel grid; 16x32 overworld frames; crisp hard edges, no antialiasing, blur or gradients; deep blue-grey 1px character outlines; limited muted palette with slate, soot brown, moss, rust/brass and bone; flat shades with top-left light; transparent background; no text or watermark.

assets.prompt: STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset): Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, readable cozy-clean classic farming/life-sim style, dark and atmospheric. Original foggy Victorian industrial world with occult undertones. Strict 16x16 pixel tiles; overworld characters 16x32 per frame; every pixel aligned, no sub-pixel detail. Crisp hard edges, no antialiasing, blur or gradients; deliberate two-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces. 1px deep blue-grey outline around #1a1c2c on characters and props; no terrain in these assets. Muted palette of at most 32 colors: slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, moss greens, rust, brass, bone white; warm amber only for lamps and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult effects. Flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps and top-left light; do not bake night darkness. Melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory. Transparent background, orthographic, no text, letters, numbers, watermark or signature. Avoid 3D, painterly, photorealistic, chibi, anime eyes, and references to existing games, films or franchises. Wenna Kolk, broad elderly peat mother in layered peat-brown clothes with moss flecks, reed-strewn grey hair and a peat spade used as a walking stick. Four by four overworld sheet; rows down, left, right, up; four subtly alternating walk frames per direction; feet on baseline y=30.
